title: Unify reading plan actions into a dropdown menu matching playlists
summary: Reading plans used to show their Share, Edit and Delete actions as a row of separate buttons, and Delete asked "Delete for good?" right on the button. Now each reading plan has a ⋮ options menu, the same as playlists, and Delete asks in a pop-up confirmation box first. The delete confirmation box for playlists and notes was also merged into one shared box, so those should behave exactly as before.

links.label: Issue 1867: Reading plan options should match those of playlists

setup.title: Open the preview build
setup.body: Use the **Open the preview build** link above in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari on a computer. If the page shows an error or doesn't load, wait a few minutes and reload: the build may still be deploying.

setup.title: Make sure you're seeing the new version
setup.body: The app saves a copy of itself in your browser, so it can show the old version. Do a hard refresh once the page has loaded: **Ctrl+Shift+R** on Windows, or **Cmd+Shift+R** on Mac.

setup.title: Sign in
setup.body: Reading plans need an account. Sign in with your email; you'll need an inbox you can check for the sign-in code. A private/incognito window gives you a clean start.

setup.title: Open the reading plans screen
setup.body: In the reader toolbar (the icon buttons around the Bible text), select **Plans** (an open-book icon). If you don't see it, look in the toolbar's overflow or "more" menu. If there's no **Plans** button at all, reading plans may be turned off for your account: mark the tests **Blocked** and say so in a note.

setup.title: Create three short test plans
setup.body: On the reading plans screen, select **Create reading plan** and follow the steps. Name the plan `Test plan A`, add one reading (for example **John 1**), and finish creating it. Do the same for `Test plan B` and `Test plan C`. Short plans with one reading each make later tests quicker. Don't start any of them yet: they should all show under **Not started**.

sections.title: The options menu on plan cards
sections.intro: The cards on the reading plans screen, under Not started, Active and Completed.

tests.title: A not-started plan card has a ⋮ options menu with Share plan, Edit plan and Delete
tests.why: This is the main change in the PR (issue 1867): the actions move into a menu like the one on playlists.
steps: On the reading plans screen, find **Test plan A** under **Not started**.
Select the **⋮** (three dots) button on the right side of its card.
expected: A small menu opens with **Share plan**, **Edit plan**, and **Delete** (Delete in a warning color, like on playlists).
There is no longer a separate row of share / edit icons and a **Delete** button underneath the card.
An arrow sits just to the left of the **⋮** button on the card.

tests.title: Opening the menu doesn't open the plan, but clicking the card still does
tests.why: The card itself is clickable and the menu button sits inside it, so a click on ⋮ must not also open the plan.
steps: Select **⋮** on **Test plan A**, then press **Esc** (or click somewhere empty) to close the menu.
Do that two more times, clicking the **⋮** button near its edge each time.
Now click the plan's title on the card.
expected: Selecting **⋮** only opens the menu; you stay on the list of plans every time.
Clicking the title opens the plan's own screen. Use the back arrow to return to the list.

tests.title: Share plan copies a link to the plan
steps: Select **⋮** on **Test plan A**, then **Share plan**.
Open a new browser tab, paste into the address bar (**Ctrl+V** on Windows, **Cmd+V** on Mac) and press Enter.
expected: The menu closes and a message says **Reading plan URL copied to clipboard**.
The pasted link opens Seed Bible on **Test plan A**.
Keep this link: the "someone else's plan" test later uses it.

tests.title: Edit plan opens the plan in the editor
steps: Back on the reading plans screen, select **⋮** on **Test plan A**, then **Edit plan**.
expected: The plan editor opens with **Test plan A**'s name and its reading filled in.
Leave the editor without changing anything (close it or use the back arrow).

tests.title: Delete asks in a confirmation box, and Cancel keeps the plan
tests.why: Delete used to ask "Delete for good?" on the button itself. Now it asks in a pop-up box, like playlists do.
steps: Select **⋮** on **Test plan C**, then **Delete**.
Read the box that appears, then select **Cancel**.
expected: A box titled **Delete reading plan?** appears, saying **Delete "Test plan C"? This can't be undone.**, with **Cancel** and **Delete** buttons.
The menu item never changes to read "Delete for good?".
After **Cancel**, the box closes and **Test plan C** is still in the list.

tests.title: Confirming Delete removes the plan
steps: Select **⋮** on **Test plan C**, then **Delete**.
In the box, select **Delete**.
Reload the page (**Ctrl+R** on Windows, **Cmd+R** on Mac) and open **Plans** again.
expected: The box closes and **Test plan C** disappears from the list.
No error message appears.
After the reload, **Test plan C** is still gone.

tests.title: An active plan's card has the same menu
tests.before: Start **Test plan A**: open it and select **Start plan**, then go back to the list. It should now show under **Active**.
steps: Under **Active**, look at the **Test plan A** card, then select its **⋮** button.
Close the menu, then click the card's title.
expected: The card still shows its progress bar and day information.
The menu has **Share plan**, **Edit plan**, and **Delete**, and opening it doesn't open the plan.
Clicking the title opens the plan.

tests.title: A completed plan's card has the menu next to Restart
tests.before: Finish **Test plan A**: open it, mark its one reading (and the day, if asked) complete, then go back to the list. It should now show under **Completed**. If you can't get it to Completed, mark this test **Skip** and say why.
steps: Under **Completed**, look at the **Test plan A** card.
Select its **⋮** button, and look at the menu.
expected: The card shows a **Restart** button and a **⋮** button.
The menu has **Share plan**, **Edit plan**, and **Delete**.
Opening the menu doesn't open the plan or restart it.

sections.title: The options menu on a plan's own screen
sections.intro: The screen you get when you open a plan.

tests.title: An open plan has a ⋮ menu instead of separate buttons
steps: From the list, open **Test plan B**.
Find the **⋮** button near the top of the plan's screen, by the progress summary, and select it.
expected: The menu has **Share plan**, **Edit plan**, and **Delete**.
There are no longer separate share / edit icons or a **Delete** button on this screen.

tests.title: Deleting from the plan's screen goes back to the list
steps: On **Test plan B**'s screen, select **⋮**, then **Delete**.
In the **Delete reading plan?** box, select **Delete**.
expected: The box closes and you're taken back to the list of plans.
**Test plan B** is no longer in the list.

tests.title: Someone else's plan has no Edit plan in its menu
tests.why: Only the person who made a plan can edit it, so Edit plan should be hidden for everyone else. Share plan and Delete are still offered.
tests.before: You need a second account. Open a different browser, or a private/incognito window, and sign in there with a different email address.
steps: In the second browser, paste the link you copied in the **Share plan** test and open it.
On the plan's screen, select **⋮**.
expected: The plan opens.
The menu shows **Share plan** and **Delete**, but no **Edit plan**.

setup.title: Make the window narrow
setup.body: Open the preview on a phone, or make your browser window as narrow as it will go, then reload and open **Plans**. Create a new plan named `Test plan D` with one reading if your list is empty.

tests.title: The ⋮ button fits on plan cards on a narrow screen
steps: Look at the plan cards in the list.
Tap **⋮** on one of them.
expected: The **⋮** button is fully visible on each card and doesn't overlap the title, arrow, or **Restart** button.
The menu opens fully on screen and tapping **⋮** doesn't open the plan.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed
sections.intro: The delete confirmation box for playlists and notes now uses the same shared box as reading plans, so check they still work the same way.

tests.title: Deleting a reading plan from Your content still asks first
tests.before: Have at least one reading plan (create `Test plan E` with one reading if needed).
steps: Open your profile: on a wide window, click your **profile picture / initials** in the left sidebar; on a phone-sized window, tap **You** in the bottom bar. Then choose **Your content**.
Find a reading plan in the list (use the **Reading plans** filter if there is one) and select its **⋮** button, then **Delete**.
Select **Cancel**, then do it again and select **Delete**.
expected: The **Delete reading plan?** box names the plan, for example **Delete "Test plan E"? This can't be undone.**
**Cancel** keeps the plan; **Delete** removes it from the list.

tests.title: Deleting a playlist still asks first and works
tests.before: Have a playlist you don't mind losing. If you have none, create one named `Test playlist` (from **Your content**, **+ Create** then **Playlist**).
steps: In **Your content**, find the playlist and select its **⋮** button, then **Delete**.
Select **Cancel**, then do it again and select **Delete**.
expected: A box titled **Delete playlist?** says **Delete "Test playlist"? This can't be undone.**
**Cancel** keeps the playlist; **Delete** removes it with no error message.

tests.title: Deleting a note still asks first and works
tests.before: Open **John 3** and write a short note on a verse (type `Testing delete`). It should appear in the **Discover John** panel beside the text.
steps: In the **Discover John** panel, find your note and select its **⋮** button, then **Delete**.
Select **Cancel**, then do it again and select **Delete**.
expected: A box titled **Delete annotation?** says **Delete this annotation? This can't be undone.**
**Cancel** keeps the note; **Delete** removes it with no error message.

notCovered: While a delete is still running, the Cancel and Delete buttons in the confirmation box are now greyed out so a double-click can't delete twice. On a normal connection this lasts too short a moment to see.
The "Couldn't delete the reading plan." message shown when a delete fails, which can't be triggered on purpose from the app.
Draft plans (the Drafts section) keep their own **Discard** button that asks "Delete for good?"; this PR doesn't change them.
Internal clean-up: three copies of the delete confirmation box were merged into one.
